what_worked: The intermittent test failure was a clock dependency, not a logic bug. Freezing time with freezegun at the test boundary made it deterministic. The real fix was injecting a clock into the service constructor instead of calling datetime.now() inline.
what_failed: Spent ~20 minutes adding retries and sleeps to the test, assuming it was a network race. It never was — re-running 'until it passes' hid the actual non-determinism and would have left the bug in prod.
better_exit_condition: Stop as soon as a 'flaky' test passes on retry but fails in isolation — that pattern means non-determinism in the code under test, not the test harness. Don't declare done until the test passes 20/20 in isolation.
